voice_rules: Aim for roughly 60–35 words unless the idea needs less.
Use short paragraphs and concrete examples before abstract conclusions.
Write in first person only for experience the author explicitly supplied.
Make one clear claim and connect every factual statement to supplied evidence.
End with a specific implication or focused question, not a generic engagement prompt.
Do not add hashtags unless the author requests them.

draft.post_text:
The useful part of making AI-assisted writing inspectable is not the first draft.

A trustworthy making AI-assisted writing inspectable workflow makes its evidence and approval gates visible.

The workflow separates source material, voice rules, claims, and visual decisions. Each stage can be reviewed before the next one begins.

What grounds this draft:
• The workflow separates corpus audit, voice approval, claim approval, storyboard approval, and export.
• Raw historical post text remains local and is excluded from model payloads.
• Each completed pair includes a post, storyboard, GIF, fallback PNG, alt text, and manifest.

That makes the result easier to revise—and easier to stand behind.
